falsificationFindings: Formosa Chemicals shows an outlook downgrade can precede a formal notch downgrade by a long interval; counting both as independent fresh negative shocks without anticipation controls would double count.
Wan Hai demonstrates a sequence Negative→Stable→Positive→Upgrade, proving outlook/watch states are economically distinct from notch migration.
TCC demonstrates outlook deterioration and later normalization with the same rating, so binary upgrade/downgrade data discards relevant state changes.
No event above is treated as a stock-direction signal; market anticipation and fundamentals must be controlled before any outcome test.

maturityDecision.rationale: Exact-dated issuer-rating/outlook events are independently replayable across multiple Taiwan non-financial industries and multiple dates, with event type and prior/new state preserved. L3 validates PIT data feasibility only.

next: Add issue-rating events and CreditWatch/review events to separate issuer and instrument information.
Join pre-event D22-06 credit pricing and equity/fundamental state without opening outcomes until anticipation controls are preregistered.
Build event clustering rules so outlook, watch and downgrade within one deterioration episode do not become multiple independent votes.
Proceed to L4 only with OOS/walk-forward/prospective evidence.
